nirncraft.calendar.quest.title: Festival Errand: %s
nirncraft.calendar.quest.objective: Take part in the %s celebrations and speak with the townsfolk
nirncraft.calendar.festival.new_life_fes: Braziers blaze in Windhelm's Stone Quarter as Nords toast the return of the sun with free spiced mead!
nirncraft.calendar.festival.south_winds_: Lanterns hang beneath Whiterun's Gildergreen as priests of Kynareth pray for mild winds and a fruitful thaw.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.hearts_day.a: Pink banners and sweetroll stalls line Riften's canals as the Temple of Mara blesses betrothed couples.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.first_planti: Farmers in Rorikstead and the Whiterun plains bless the ploughs and share fresh loaves for the spring sowing.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.dawnstar_ice: Dawnstar's harbour rings with bells as the Sea of Ghosts pack ice cracks and the first spring ships set sail.
Bards College troubadours fill Solitude's cobbled avenue with riddles, street theatre, and festive banners!
nirncraft.calendar.festival.second_plant: Falkreath drapes its pine archways in spring garlands as Arkay's priests bless the late-spring planting.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.morthal_midy: Soul lanterns glow along Morthal's boardwalks as townsfolk renew the midsummer wards against the marsh fog.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.burning_of_k: The Bards College lights King Olaf's effigy bonfire in Solitude and pours spiced wine for all travellers!
nirncraft.calendar.festival.merchants_fe: Whiterun's Plains District bustles with open market stalls and caravan traders for the Merchants' Festival.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.markarth_sil: Markarth's Dwemer terraces shine with silver filigree stalls and floral offerings from the Temple of Dibella.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.harvests_end: Golden birch leaves drift over Riften's square as the autumn harvest casks are tapped free for Harvest's End!
nirncraft.calendar.festival.tales_and_ta: Candlelit vigils warm Falkreath's twilight as storytellers honour the dead and ward the ancient barrows.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.winterhold_a: Magelight lanterns illuminate Winterhold beneath the autumn aurora as College scholars trade scrolls and charms.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.witches_fest: Bonfires crackle in Morthal as apothecaries and monster hunters gather for the Frostfall Witches' Festival.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.warriors_fes: Smiths and veterans display honed steel in Windhelm to honour Ysgramor's Five Hundred Companions.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.saturalia_ol: Warm Saturalia lanterns line Dawnstar's snowy quays as townsfolk exchange gifts and remember the year past.

nirncraft.scene.wonder.mammoth_herd: A giant herder guides painted mammoths across the open steppe.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.pilgrims_at_shrin: Pilgrims kneel in quiet prayer before a wayside shrine.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.whiterun_mammoth_: A giant herder guides painted mammoths across the tundra in the golden dawn light.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.aurora_sky_watche: Scholars and a bard gather by lantern light to watch the northern aurora ripple overhead.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.distant_dragon_ri: A dragon surveys the valley from a high rocky ridge while travellers watch from cover.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.kynareth_sapling_: Priests of Kynareth carry sacred sapling offerings along the high road.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.sea_of_ghosts_hor: A massive pod of horkers basks on the Sea of Ghosts pack ice as coastal fishers watch the tide.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.meridia_beacon_pi: Dawn light catches a hilltop shrine while priests chant against the undead.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.bards_college_tro: Travelling Bards College musicians rehearse King Olaf's verse along the road.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.falkreath_lantern: Solemn priests of Arkay and mourners bear lanterns along the pine road.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.spriggan_ancient_: Glowing butterflies and woodland deer gather peacefully around a guardian spriggan.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.moonlight_stag_ap: A great stag stands in a moonlit glade surrounded by drifting torchbugs.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.drajkmyr_wisp_pro: Luminous wisps and torchbugs drift silently across the fog-shrouded fen.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.labyrinthian_ghos: Scholars study ancient dragon-cult stones where restless shadows stir in the mist.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.morthal_fen_torch: Boardwalk watchmen light ward-fires through the salt-marsh fog at dusk.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.dwemer_great_lift: An expedition camp studies a venting Dwemer lift while a brass automaton patrols.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.vaermina_sleeples: A priest of Mara prays over sleepwalking townsfolk beneath the northern stars.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.golden_birch_pilg: Voice pilgrims and a bard climb the road beneath falling golden birch leaves.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.mara_wedding_proc: A joyful betrothed couple and a priest of Mara travel down the road with a bard.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.azura_twilight_ch: Dunmer pilgrims chant at twilight toward the mountain shrine of Dusk and Dawn.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.college_atronach_: College of Winterhold mages conduct an outdoor conjuration trial on the ice.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.steam_basin_mammo: Mammoths wade in steaming geothermal pools while a giant stands watch on the sulphur rim.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.stormcloak_vetera: Veterans march at dusk while a bard sings of Ysgramor and old Skyrim.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.karth_gorge_dibel: Priestesses of Dibella cross the misty Karth gorge bearing floral offerings.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.sky_haven_cliff_e: Scholars trace ancient Akaviri carvings below the crags of the Reach.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.wispmother_frost_: A spectral Wispmother and orbiting wisps illuminate a frozen hollow.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.morrowind_silt_st: A towering Silt Strider and pack guar rest with Dunmer caravanners near the eastern pass.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.valenwood_indrik_: A luminous Indrik grazes in a misty woodland glade among butterflies.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.v8_fest_cyro: Torches blaze across Bruma's snow-terraces as Nords and Legionnaires tap the spring mead-casks for the Pale Pass Thaw!
Great Oak Assize & Highland Fleece Fair
Shepherds, loggers, and Fighters Guild champions gather beneath Chorrol's Great Oak for the Highland Fleece Fair!
Imperial City Arena Grand Championship & Ruby Jubilee
Trumpets sound from the Imperial City Arena as the Grand Championship bouts and Ruby Jubilee markets open across the capital!
Great Forest Wayshrine Vigil & Woodland Fair
Soul-lanterns glow along the Great Forest road at Weye as priests and scholars bless the woodland wayshrines!
Painted paper lanterns drift beneath Cheydinhal's willow bridges as Dunmer and Nibenese houses open the spring silk regatta!
Skingrad Colovian Wine Harvest & First Cask Tapping
Skingrad's cobbled squares run red with the first pressings as the Surilie and Tamika estates tap the autumn Wine Harvest casks!
Anvil Golden Sail & Dibellan Lighthouse Fair
Anvil's great lighthouse blazes golden over the Abecean Sea as Dibella's priestesses and Kvatch masons open the harbour fair!
Gala of the Lucky Old Lady & Niben Barge-Moot
Barge-horns echo through Bravil's canals as river-folk toss copper wish-coins for the Gala of the Lucky Old Lady!
Topal Bay Reed-Lantern Vigil & Zenithar Scale-Day
Reed-lanterns shimmer on the Niben mouth at Leyawiin as Imperial, Saxhleel, and Khajiit traders celebrate Zenithar's Scale-Day!
nirncraft.scene.wonder.v8_cyr_wonder_ayl: An ancient Ayleid star-well ignites with azure welkynd light under the night sky while torchbugs gather.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.v8_cyr_wonder_whi: Pilgrims and a bard pause along the ridge as the distant vesper-chimes of the Nine Divines echo across Cyrodiil.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.v8_cyr_wonder_emp: White-robed priests of the Nine carry brass thuribles and blessed loaves between roadside wayshrines.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.v8_cyr_wonder_min: A solitary horned minotaur kneels peacefully beside a weathered First Era Alessian boundary-stone.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.v8_fest_morr: Inner Sea Charter-Moot & Ebonheart Regatta
Lanterns blaze along Ebonheart's harbour-terrace as the Grand Council and East Empire fleets open the Inner Sea Charter-Moot!
Procession of Mother Morrowind's Mercy
Brass censers perfume Mournhold's Great Bazaar and Godsreach as the Procession of Mother Morrowind's Mercy begins!
Vigil of the White Walls & Ancestor-Lantern Night
Thousands of white ancestor-lanterns glow along the ossuary walls of Necrom for the Vigil of the White Walls!
Sadrith Mora Spore-Bloom & Magisterial Fair
Bioluminescent spores drift over Sadrith Mora's Gateway Plaza as the Tel Naga Magisterial Fair opens its stalls!
Dagon Fel Whale-Boat Return & Sanctus Vigil
The northern watchtower brazier blazes above Dagon Fel as Nord whalers and Dunmer islanders celebrate the Whale-Boat Return!
Muster of Skar & Ashlander Gate-Truce
Redoran horns echo beneath the giant crab-shell of Skar in Ald'ruhn as the Ashlander Gate-Truce market opens!
Vos Golden Wickwheat Harvest & Herd-Compact
Golden sheaves of wickwheat deck the mushroom-rooted square of Vos for the Grazelands Harvest & Herd-Compact!
Twilight Vigil of Azura's Coast
Soul-lanterns shimmer through the twilight mist at Molag Mar as pilgrims gather for the Vigil of Azura's Coast!
Balmora Odai Barge-Fair & Hlaalu Assay Day
Banners of House Hlaalu flutter across Balmora's Odai River bridges for the midsummer Barge-Fair & Assay Day!
Gnaar Mok Netch-Lantern Tide & Fisher's Truce
Amber netch-lanterns float above the stilt-piers of Gnaar Mok as fishers celebrate the Bitter Coast Lantern Tide!
Jubilee of the Seven Graces & Canton Regatta
Decorated gondolas glide between the golden cantons of Vivec City as choir-bells ring for the Jubilee of the Seven Graces!
Vigil of the Two Towers & Ancestor-Pylon Renewal
Blue ancestor-braziers flare between the Tower of Dawn and Tower of Dusk at Ghostgate for the Vigil of the Two Towers!
Raven Rock Bulwark-Watch & All-Maker Hearth-Truce
Hearth-fires roar along Raven Rock's southern bulwark as Dunmer councillors and Skaal hunters share the winter Hearth-Truce!
nirncraft.scene.wonder.v8_mw_wonder_silt: A caravan guide tends amber chitin-lanterns at dusk as the low, haunting call of a silt-strider echoes across the ash-valley.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.v8_mw_wonder_ghos: Buoyant Armigers and a pilgrim kneel on a basalt ridge as the distant blue ancestor-aurora of the Ghostfence ripples against the night sky.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.v8_mw_wonder_empe: Golden bioluminescent spores drift down from a towering Emperor Parasol mushroom while a Telvanni scholar sketches by lantern-light.
nirncraft.scene.wonder.v8_mw_wonder_skaa: A Skaal shaman and northern hunters chant the Song of the Wind beside a frost-rimmed standing stone at twilight.
nirncraft.calendar.festival.v8_fest_blac: Day of the Sundered Shackle & Percolating Mire Fair
Hammers ring against the shackle-cairns of Thorn as Chain-Breaker clans gather for the Day of the Sundered Shackle!
Soul-lanterns shimmer above Stormhold's Barsaebic ring-walls as Tree-Minders open the Shadow-Sign Natal Vigil!
Amber lanterns glow beneath the great boughs of Helstrom as the Root-Heart tribes gather for the Hist Sap-Naming Communion!
Punt-horns echo along Gideon's stone levees as townsfolk and marsh-clans tap the casks for the Levee-Rice Harvest!
Silver reed-lanterns drift across Lilmoth's harbour as dock syndicates and boatmen celebrate the Silver-Bell Tide!
Bone-flutes and drums echo from Murkmire's stepped Xanmeer plazas for the Sithis Calendar-Turn Feast!
nirncraft.calendar.festival.v8_fest_elsw: Caravan bells ring across Riverhold's sandstone plazas as northern well-clans open the Anequina Well-Compact Moot!
Rimmen Night of Painted Masks & Aqueduct Fair
Gilded masks and paper lanterns fill Rimmen's aqueduct plazas for the Night of Painted Masks!
Torval Two-Moons Alignment & Cedar Sanctum Jubilee
Bronze moon-bells chime from Torval's cedar sanctuaries as the Mane's court opens the Two-Moons Alignment Jubilee!
Corinthe First-Boil Sugar Harvest & Garden Blessing
Sweet steam rises from Corinthe's plaza kettles as Pellitine celebrates the First-Boil Sugar Harvest!
Silk sails and Khenarthi wind-pennants brighten Senchal's harbour for the Gilded Regatta!
nirncraft.calendar.festival.v8_fest_vale: Bone-horns sound through the deep canopy of Silvenar for the Green Lady's Bough-Union Feast!
Bosmer hunters and Khajiit traders gather in Arenthia's plaza to celebrate the autumn Bone-Truce Moot!
Thousands of amber gourd-lamps illuminate the great boughs of Elden Root for the Crown-Lamp Jubilee!
Spinners' songs and harbour lanterns fill the root-bridges of Woodhearth for the spring Wilder-Song Tide!
nirncraft.calendar.festival.v8_fest_summ: Alinor Festival of Eightfold Refraction & Ancestor Lamps
Prismatic sun-beams and ancestor-lamps blaze across Alinor's glass spires for the Festival of Eightfold Refraction!
Cherry blossoms and golden banners drift over Firsthold's marble courts for the Festival of Auri-El's Ascent!
Artaeum Conclave of the Old Ways & Syrabane's Vigil
Quiet star-lanterns shimmer across the timeless orchards of Artaeum for the Conclave of the Old Ways!
nirncraft.calendar.festival.v8_fest_fore: Kjolvik Summer-Lead Break & Whale-Totem Hearth
Driftwood bonfires roar on the frozen shingle of Kjolvik as the summer pack-ice leads open!
Jylkurfyk Keel-Remembrance & Rime-Barrow Watch
Torches flare beside the ancient stone slipways of Jylkurfyk for the Keel-Remembrance Vigil!
Day of the Crimson Lacquer Seal & Canal Truce
Gongs sound from the Black Lacquer Pagoda as Tsaesci custodians unseal the spring treaty market!
Ada'Soom's Gate Thaw-Watch & Iron-Brazier Muster
Steam-braziers roar at Ada'Soom's Gate as the pass wardens muster for the Kamal Thaw-Watch!
Tang Mo Cloud-Bamboo & Strait Lantern Festival
Woven bamboo lanterns sway across the suspension bridges of Tang Mo Harbor for the Strait Lantern Festival!
Tosh Raka's Golden Steppe & Dragon-Bell Zenith
Great bronze dragon-bells thunder across the golden steppe at Tosh Raka's Palace for the Dragon-Bell Zenith!
Vigil of the Warrior Constellation & Ansei Memory
Memory-stones hum beneath the desert stars at the Hall of the Ansei for the Vigil of the Warrior Constellation!
Equinox Low-Tide Salvage & Drowned Kings' Vigil
Copper lamps gleam along the exposed causeways of the Sunken Isles for the Equinox Low-Tide Vigil!
Tide of the Coiled King & Black Pearl Truce-Fair
Conch-horns echo through the sea-mist at the Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage for the Tide of the Coiled King!
Night of the Phosphor-Tide & Sandbar Exchange
Green phosphor-lights rise from the lagoon around the Coral Tower of Thras for the Sandbar Exchange!
